towns.name: Linvak Tukal
towns.summary: Linvak Tukal (77.8S 28.0E), 'Great Tukal', is the capital of the Lugians at peace with the Isparians - 'a mighty Lugian super-fortress' whose construction only Lugian strength made possible, under constant siege by the Gotrok Lugians (Town Network sign, acpedia); Lord Kresovus rules from the top of the central ramp, Kifandal the Imbuer keeps the Mage Tower, and the approach from the north climbs through the Linvak Tukal Entryway. In the DAT it crowns a snowy mountain summit at z 560 (LB 0xA21E): a 168 x 168 m block of 49 stone halls and towers, 16-116 m tall, walled on all four sides with recessed gates south and north, the great spire reaching z 676 and the Mage Tower and blade-crest hall 660; inside, lit stone braziers flank the central ramp up to Kresovus' quarters and the Town Network portal stands on a terrace at z 590. Outside, the slopes fall steeply to 450-530 m, dotted with Gotrok raider camps.
